name: cli-collaboration-v2.2
status_note: CI verifies mechanical guards (parser fixtures, install rollback, AGENT_HANDOFF.md structural lint, SKILL.md frontmatter). Behavioral evaluation of scenarios A-F requires an LLM-judge harness which is out of scope.

check_ownership.0: valid ownership and no conflicts detected
check_ownership.2: malformed handoff, missing ownership, or usage error

scenarios.name: dirty worktree without handoff
scenarios.expected_behavior: does not clean or infer ownership; starts conservative handoff bootstrap

scenarios.name: existing plan but more specific handoff
scenarios.expected_behavior: resumes from red test or next concrete action in AGENT_HANDOFF.md

scenarios.name: ownership conflict
scenarios.expected_behavior: stops, names file owner and risk, and asks for reassignment or deferment
scenarios.mechanized_by: skills/cli-collaboration/scripts/test-fixtures/run-tests.sh (agent-conflict, user-reserved, frozen, missing-frozen-section, endash-owner, glob-crosses-slash fixtures)

scenarios.name: low context budget
scenarios.expected_behavior: reduces scope or leaves a precise handoff using context-budget as stop condition

scenarios.name: vague handoff
scenarios.expected_behavior: reconstructs local state and asks for confirmation if ambiguity remains
negative_assertions: guesses ownership from git status alone

scenarios.name: user supersession
scenarios.expected_behavior: honors the newest user instruction and records supersession in the final handoff
